summary.text: Green Crystal Hero's Path is a top tier mortal killer move Zombie Alliance researched.

claims.text: Gu Ye mobilizes primeval essence on a ruined plaza and activates green crystal hero’s path. The floor turns translucent like a giant jade. Green jade light circulates, and shadows of countless Gu worms flutter in it. Space path Gu at rank five and wood path Gu at rank four fly from his body and revolve like a hurricane until a vast bluish-green patch forms.

Ordinary transport cannot move immortal zombies, because their bodies are filled with dao marks. Connecting heaven Gu and hole earth Gu also fail them, because of their dead apertures. Those mortal Gu can connect blessed lands or grotto-heavens because the two small worlds involved silently consume heavenly power. A dead blessed land or grotto-heaven cannot expend heavenly power. Setting connecting heaven Gu and hole earth Gu needs the consent of both sides. Only then can the immortal apertures use heavenly power. If those Gu are set up in secret, they cannot connect, because heavenly power is absent. The move links old earth wood to Zombie Alliance’s garrison. Gu Ye spent two years looking after the myriad poison date tree to earn the contribution points to exchange for it. Anyone who takes tasks outside must grasp it, or they cannot reach the alliance at any time.

A thick green light soars from dried yellow old earth branches and leaves. Over a hundred thousand li away, a dark green light falls on a southeast plaza in Dark Flow City, dyes the surroundings green, and leaves Gu Ye and Fang Yuan standing there when it fades.
